# UAEworkrights

> UAE employment compliance. Independent review of settlement letters and employment contracts against UAE Labour Law (Federal Decree-Law 33/2021), plus compliance audits for employers. Covers MOHRE mainland, DIFC, ADGM and free zones.

UAEworkrights is run by a payroll and compliance specialist, not a law firm. We provide written compliance findings, not legal representation.

## Services

- Employment Contract & Settlement Review: AED 999 flat fee, with written findings within 48 hours
- Self-Review Knowledge Base: AED 199 for 30-day access; customers receive guidance and tools, then review their own documents. No personalized review is included.
- Employer compliance audit: from AED 5,000

## Guides

- [How UAE gratuity is calculated](https://uaeworkrights.com/guides/uae-gratuity-calculation): The MOHRE mainland formula step by step, the 21 and 30 day rules, basic vs gross salary, and resignation under FDL 33/2021.
- [Do free zones have their own employment law?](https://uaeworkrights.com/guides/free-zone-employment-law): JAFZA, DMCC and most free zones follow federal law. Only DIFC and ADGM differ.
- [Executive Shield compliance guide](https://uaeworkrights.com/executive-shield): Free guide for employers on the compliance gaps that most often become MOHRE disputes.

## Key facts

- Gratuity is calculated on basic salary only, excluding allowances.
- Under Federal Decree-Law 33/2021, full gratuity is due whether you resign or are terminated. The old pre-2022 reduction for resigning before five years no longer applies.
- No gratuity is due below one full year of continuous service, though leave encashment, notice pay and unpaid salary may still be owed.
- DIFC and ADGM operate their own employment law; most other free zones follow the federal law.
